scenes.caption: The Future Traveler reaches HAXcms through the MCP.
Sign in, pick a site, create pages.
Write content: one typed tool per HAX element, so an agent places the right block.
Files, settings, outline, exports and imports.
Every tool calls the same OpenAPI areas people use; open OpenAPI to see them.
